customer_question: We want to change the email address on our SIG member account. Is it possible to update the email address on an existing account?
question_variants: How do I change my SIG account email address?
Can we update the registered email on a SIG member account?
We changed company email domains — how do we update the SIG account?
actual_issue: Customer ATAGO Co. wanted to change the email address associated with their existing SIG member account. SIG does not allow email modification on an existing account.
plain_english_explanation: The SIG system does not support changing the email address on an existing member account. Instead, the customer must register a new account with the new email address (under the same member company). Both the old and the new accounts can be used to access and work on the same projects.
consultant_answer: SIG does not permit email address modification on an existing account. The solution is to create a new SIG account using the new email address within the same member company. Both accounts can coexist and be used simultaneously on the same qualification projects.
decision_logic: SIG member accounts are tied to a specific email address and cannot be edited. Adding a new account under the same company membership is the supported path. The SIG system allows multiple accounts per member company, and all accounts can access the same project workspace.
final_recommendation: If a customer needs to change their SIG account email, instruct them to register a new account using the new email address. Their old and new accounts will both work, and they can transfer ongoing project responsibilities to the new account.
risk_if_done_wrong: Attempting to modify the email on an existing account is not possible and wastes time. If the old account is the Registrant on existing QDIDs/QNs, those Qualification Numbers remain tied to the registrant company (not a specific account) and are still accessible.
